Drill: Diamond Passing
Skill Category: Passing
Level: Starter
Primary Goal: Improve passing
Duration: 4 x 1 minute
Equipment: Basketball, cones
Group Requirement: Group
Instructions: Players dribble to a center cone, perform a jump stop and pivot, then make an overhead pass to the next player.
Difficulty Modification: Call receiver's name or add movement after passing
Solo Adaptation Possible: True
Solo Adaptation: Practice passing against a wall
Source: Jr. NBA Starter Practice Plan 1, page 4

Drill: Stationary Crossover Low, Mid, High
Skill Category: Ball Handling
Level: Starter
Primary Goal: Improve dribbling
Duration: 3 x 20 seconds
Equipment: Basketball
Group Requirement: Individual
Instructions: Players practice stationary crossover dribbles at low, middle, and high levels to develop ball control.
Difficulty Modification: Add partner mirroring or extra crossovers
Solo Adaptation Possible: True
Solo Adaptation: Practice stationary crossovers independently
Source: Jr. NBA Starter Practice Plan 1, page 5

Drill: Cone Dribbling
Skill Category: Ball Handling
Level: Starter
Primary Goal: Improve dribbling
Duration: 3 x down and back
Equipment: Basketball, cones
Group Requirement: Group
Instructions: Players dribble through cones in a zigzag pattern, changing hands as they change direction.
Difficulty Modification: Replace cones with defenders
Solo Adaptation Possible: True
Solo Adaptation: Dribble through cones independently
Source: Jr. NBA Starter Practice Plan 1, page 6

Drill: Form Shooting - 1 Hand
Skill Category: Shooting
Level: Starter
Primary Goal: Improve shooting
Duration: 2 x 10 shots
Equipment: Basketball, hoop
Group Requirement: Partner
Instructions: Players practice one-handed shooting close to the basket, focusing on shooting form and follow-through.
Difficulty Modification: Not specified
Solo Adaptation Possible: True
Solo Adaptation: Practice one-handed form shooting independently
Source: Jr. NBA Starter Practice Plan 1, page 8

Drill: Run To That Line
Skill Category: Warm-Up
Level: Starter
Primary Goal: Improve conditioning
Duration: 1 x 5 lines
Equipment: Basketball court
Group Requirement: Group
Instructions: Players follow movement instructions to reach different court lines, practicing movements such as skipping and high knees.
Difficulty Modification: Add basketballs or dribbling to the movements
Solo Adaptation Possible: True
Solo Adaptation: Perform court-line movements independently
Source: Jr. NBA Starter Practice Plan 1, page 2

Drill: The Chase Game
Skill Category: Ball Handling
Level: Starter
Primary Goal: Improve agility
Duration: 2-3 games
Equipment: Basketballs, court
Group Requirement: Group
Instructions: Four players take turns chasing and escaping while dribbling between court baselines.
Difficulty Modification: Require players to dribble using only their non-dominant hand
Solo Adaptation Possible: False
Solo Adaptation: Chase game requires other players
Source: Jr. NBA Starter Practice Plan 1, page 7

Drill: Decision 1 on 1
Skill Category: Shooting
Level: Starter
Primary Goal: Improve decision-making
Duration: Games to 3
Equipment: Basketball, hoop
Group Requirement: Partner
Instructions: An offensive player reads the coach's position to choose between driving for a layup and taking a jump shot while facing a defender.
Difficulty Modification: Not specified
Solo Adaptation Possible: False
Solo Adaptation: Original decision drill requires a defender and coach
Source: Jr. NBA Starter Practice Plan 1, page 9

Drill: Shoot and Follow
Skill Category: Shooting
Level: Starter
Primary Goal: Improve shooting
Duration: 3 x 2 minutes
Equipment: Basketballs, hoop
Group Requirement: Group
Instructions: Groups of three rotate through shooting, rebounding, passing, and relocating to new shooting positions.
Difficulty Modification: Change the shooting location or shot type between rounds
Solo Adaptation Possible: True
Solo Adaptation: Shoot, rebound, and relocate independently
Source: Jr. NBA Starter Practice Plan 1, page 10

Drill: Jump Stop Game
Skill Category: Footwork & Conditioning
Level: Starter
Primary Goal: Improve agility
Duration: 2 x down and back
Equipment: Basketball court
Group Requirement: Group
Instructions: Players move across the court and perform balanced jump stops in response to the coach's signals.
Difficulty Modification: Add dribbling before each jump stop
Solo Adaptation Possible: True
Solo Adaptation: Practice jump stops using predetermined court markers
Source: Jr. NBA Starter Practice Plan 1, page 11

Drill: Defense, I Love It Drill
Skill Category: Defense
Level: Starter
Primary Goal: Improve defense
Duration: 2 x 5 repetitions
Equipment: Basketball court
Group Requirement: Group
Instructions: Players practice defensive stance, lateral slides, and shot contests while following a leader's cues.
Difficulty Modification: Assign players to lead small groups and give defensive movement cues
Solo Adaptation Possible: True
Solo Adaptation: Practice defensive slides using fixed court markers
Source: Jr. NBA Starter Practice Plan 1, page 13

Drill: 3-on-2 Advantage
Skill Category: Team Concepts
Level: Starter
Primary Goal: Improve decision-making
Duration: 6 minutes
Equipment: Basketball, hoop
Group Requirement: Group
Instructions: Three offensive players compete against two defenders, using passing and quick decisions to create scoring opportunities.
Difficulty Modification: Limit offensive players to one second of ball possession
Solo Adaptation Possible: False
Solo Adaptation: 3-on-2 game requires multiple players
Source: Jr. NBA Starter Practice Plan 1, page 14

Drill: Dribble Relays
Skill Category: Ball Handling
Level: Starter
Primary Goal: Improve dribbling
Duration: 2 rounds
Equipment: Basketballs, court
Group Requirement: Group
Instructions: Teams compete in dribbling relays, performing jump stops and returning to their teammates before switching hands.
Difficulty Modification: Replace backpedaling with defensive slides or sprinting
Solo Adaptation Possible: True
Solo Adaptation: Perform timed dribbling runs independently
Source: Jr. NBA Starter Practice Plan 1, page 15

Drill: 3 on 3 Numbers Game
Skill Category: Team Concepts
Level: Starter
Primary Goal: Improve court awareness
Duration: Games to 5 points
Equipment: Basketball, hoop
Group Requirement: Group
Instructions: Numbered teams compete in short three-on-three possessions, practicing offensive teamwork and active defense.
Difficulty Modification: Not specified
Solo Adaptation Possible: False
Solo Adaptation: 3-on-3 game requires multiple players
Source: Jr. NBA Starter Practice Plan 1, page 16

Drill: 1-2-3 Triple Threat
Skill Category: Footwork & Conditioning
Level: Starter
Primary Goal: Improve decision-making
Duration: 1 x 90 seconds
Equipment: Basketball
Group Requirement: Group
Instructions: Players dribble around a half court. On the coach's signal, they stop in a triple threat stance, then resume dribbling.
Difficulty Modification: Use the off-hand or add crossover dribbles.
Solo Adaptation Possible: True
Solo Adaptation: Practice dribbling and triple threat transitions using predetermined cues.
Source: Jr. NBA Starter Practice Plan 2, page 219

Drill: Retreat Dribble Drill
Skill Category: Ball Handling
Level: Starter
Primary Goal: Improve dribbling
Duration: 3 x 15 seconds
Equipment: Basketball, court
Group Requirement: Individual
Instructions: Players dribble forward to court markers, take two retreat dribbles, square up, and repeat using both hands.
Difficulty Modification: Add a crossover or between-the-legs move after the retreat.
Solo Adaptation Possible: True
Solo Adaptation: Perform the retreat dribble sequence independently.
Source: Jr. NBA Starter Practice Plan 2, page 221

Drill: Shield Steal
Skill Category: Ball Handling
Level: Starter
Primary Goal: Improve dribbling
Duration: 4 minutes
Equipment: Basketball, cones
Group Requirement: Partner
Instructions: Players work in pairs inside a marked square. One player protects the ball while the defender attempts to steal it. Players then switch roles.
Difficulty Modification: Not specified
Solo Adaptation Possible: False
Solo Adaptation: The original activity requires a defender.
Source: Jr. NBA Starter Practice Plan 2, page 222

Drill: 2 on 2 Full Court Transition Game
Skill Category: Passing
Level: Starter
Primary Goal: Improve passing
Duration: 8 minutes
Equipment: Basketball, full court, hoop
Group Requirement: Group
Instructions: Two offensive players rebound and make an outlet pass, then advance upcourt against defenders in transition.
Difficulty Modification: Not specified
Solo Adaptation Possible: False
Solo Adaptation: Original transition game requires multiple players.
Source: Jr. NBA Starter Practice Plan 2, page 223

Drill: Drop Step Lay-Up Breakdown Drill
Skill Category: Shooting
Level: Starter
Primary Goal: Improve shooting
Duration: 1 x 2 minutes each way
Equipment: Basketball
Group Requirement: Partner
Instructions: Partners roll the ball to each other and practice catching, drop-step footwork, and simulated lay-ups.
Difficulty Modification: Practice the drop step with both feet.
Solo Adaptation Possible: True
Solo Adaptation: Practice the drop-step footwork independently without the partner pass.
Source: Jr. NBA Starter Practice Plan 2, page 224

Drill: 3-Line Layups Add Variations
Skill Category: Shooting
Level: Starter
Primary Goal: Improve shooting
Duration: 3-5 minutes
Equipment: Basketball, hoop
Group Requirement: Group
Instructions: Players rotate through three lines and practice different lay-up finishes, including euro steps.
Difficulty Modification: Add euro-step finishes.
Solo Adaptation Possible: True
Solo Adaptation: Practice lay-ups from different positions around the basket independently.
Source: Jr. NBA Starter Practice Plan 2, page 225

Drill: 2 on 1 Shooting Game
Skill Category: Shooting
Level: Starter
Primary Goal: Improve shot selection
Duration: 6-7 minutes
Equipment: Basketball, hoop
Group Requirement: Group
Instructions: Two offensive players pass and shoot against one defender, using at most three passes.
Difficulty Modification: Allow two dribbles or add a third offensive player.
Solo Adaptation Possible: False
Solo Adaptation: Original game requires offensive players and a defender.
Source: Jr. NBA Starter Practice Plan 2, page 227

Drill: Pass & Cut Drill
Skill Category: Offense
Level: Starter
Primary Goal: Improve decision-making
Duration: 3 minutes each way
Equipment: Basketball, hoop
Group Requirement: Group
Instructions: Players pass to a teammate, cut toward the basket, and react to whether the cutter is defended.
Difficulty Modification: Not specified
Solo Adaptation Possible: False
Solo Adaptation: Original drill requires passing partners and a defender.
Source: Jr. NBA Starter Practice Plan 2, page 228

Drill: Circle Reads
Skill Category: Offense
Level: Starter
Primary Goal: Improve decision-making
Duration: 3-5 minutes
Equipment: Basketball, cones, hoop
Group Requirement: Partner
Instructions: A ball-handler chooses a baseline or middle drive; a teammate reacts by relocating for a shot or cutting for a lay-up.
Difficulty Modification: Not specified
Solo Adaptation Possible: False
Solo Adaptation: Original read-and-react drill requires a teammate.
Source: Jr. NBA Starter Practice Plan 2, page 229

Drill: 3 on 3 Numbers Game
Skill Category: Team Concepts
Level: Starter
Primary Goal: Improve court awareness
Duration: Games to 3
Equipment: Basketball, court, hoop
Group Requirement: Group
Instructions: The coach calls two team numbers and players compete in a live 3-on-3 possession.
Difficulty Modification: Not specified
Solo Adaptation Possible: False
Solo Adaptation: Original game requires two teams of three.
Source: Jr. NBA Starter Practice Plan 2, page 230
